channel.title: mint - markets
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: High dividend, low price: 4 stocks under ₹200 with high yield - IOCL, PTC India, Central Bank, PTL Enterprises
item.description: Indian Oil Corporation, PTC India, Central Bank of India, and PTL Enterprises are highlighted as stocks priced below ₹200 with dividend yields of 5.5%, 19%, 2.53%, and 6.25%, respectively. Dividend yield estimates annual dividend income relative to a stock’s market price.

item.title: 413% returns in 1 year: Gold jewellery stock offers bonus shares - Do you own? Check Ratio, record date
item.description: Utssav CZ Gold Jewels’ board approved a 1:1 bonus issue, subject to requisite approvals. The company plans to issue 2,49,98,000 shares, doubling its paid-up equity capital. The record date has not been announced. Shares have gained about 55% in a month and 354% so far in 2026.

item.title: Reliance Jio IPO listing on Oct 28: Will Mukesh Ambani's firm be in top 5 m-cap? RIL to hold top spot
item.description: Jio Platforms’ IPO was subscribed 22.19 times, with allotment expected on October 26. Based on its upper price band and post-issue share count, the company is estimated to have a market capitalisation of ₹10.30 lakh crore, potentially placing it among the BSE’s top five companies.

item.title: Big action! Who is Avadhut Sathe? Why SEBI ordered Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy to refund ₹546 cr - What he did?
item.description: SEBI ordered Avadhut Sathe and his trading academy to refund ₹546.17 crore, plus ₹67.87 crore in interest, for providing unregistered investment advice and research services. The regulator also imposed ₹11.5 crore in penalties and directed refunds within five months.

item.title: Reliance Jio Platforms IPO GMP, listing date and time, share price prediction for NSE, BSE debut - Details
item.description: Reliance Jio Platforms’ IPO was subscribed 22.19 times, led by 70.55-times demand from qualified institutional buyers. Its grey market premium was reported at ₹248, suggesting an estimated listing price of ₹1,367, or a 22.16% gain over the upper price band.&nbsp;

item.title: Silver price has broken below ₹2 lakh for the first time since December 2025: Is this the right time to buy for returns?
item.description: A steep sell-off pushed silver below ₹2 lakh per kg, wiping out its 2026 gains and leaving prices more than 50% below January’s record. Higher energy costs and rate-hike concerns are weighing on the metal, though analysts see potential support around ₹1,80,000– ₹1,85,000.

item.title: Crisil shareholders alerts! ₹17 per share dividend, record date announced in Q2 results; stock gained 7% in 2 weeks
item.description: Crisil approved a third interim dividend of ₹17 per share, equal to 1,700% of face value. Shareholders on record as of October 29 are eligible, with payment due by November 17, 2026. Quarterly revenue rose 20.2% year-on-year to ₹1,095.16 crore.

item.title: Godrej Properties Q2 profit plunges 62% to ₹154 crore, real estate stock down 6.5% in 1 week - What next for investors
item.description: Godrej Properties shares closed 4.23% lower after the company reported a 62% annual decline in Q2 net profit to ₹154.15 crore. Analyst cites rising costs and profitability as key concerns.

item.title: IT stocks Q2 results analysis: Infosys vs TCS vs Wipro vs HCL vs TechM: Who wins profit, revenue, dividend, AI race?
item.description: Q2FY27 results showed diverging fortunes among India’s largest IT firms. Tech Mahindra topped profit and revenue growth, HCLTech improved its outlook, and TCS led in deal wins and AI revenue scale. Infosys offered the biggest interim dividend, while Wipro reported the weakest trends in profit.

item.title: Cables and wires stock turned multibagger with 318% return in 5 years; InCred sees 29% upside - Do you own? Target price
item.description: KEI Industries reported strong September-quarter results, with revenue up 39%, EBITDA up 40% and profit after tax up nearly 29%. InCred Equities upgraded the stock to Add. Check target price

item.title: Power stock to buy: Despite almost 20% fall in 1 month, Deven Choksey Research sees 72% returns ahead - Do you own?
item.description: Deven Choksey Research initiated coverage of Siemens Energy India with a Buy rating and a ₹4,554 target, indicating 72% upside from ₹2,649. The brokerage sees growth from India’s transmission investment, renewable integration, and more.

item.title: Dividend, split, rights issue, buyback next week: Hexaware Tech, Cyient, RailTel to Sagility - Check record dates
item.description: At least 25 companies have set record dates between October 26 and 30 for corporate actions, including dividends, rights issues and resolution plan suspensions. Hexaware Technologies, Shriram Finance, RailTel and others are among the companies in focus.

item.title: Infosys shares: Should you buy the IT stock after Q2 results, dividend 2026 announcement? Expert view on what to do
item.description: Infosys posted higher September-quarter profit and revenue, with AI-related sales contributing 10.5% of total revenue. However, it lowered its FY27 growth guidance amid intense competition, cautious client spending and pricing pressure.&nbsp;

item.title: Gold rates in Chennai city crash this week: Can yellow metal rebound ahead of Diwali - Key levels to watch in future?
item.description: Gold prices fell sharply this week as rising oil prices, inflation concerns and expectations of tighter US monetary policy pressured bullion. MCX futures dropped around 3.5%, while Chennai retail 24K gold prices declined 3.85% to ₹1,42,480 per 10 grams.

item.title: Reliance Jio Platforms IPO allotment status check online by PAN number on NSE India, BSE websites: Direct link, steps
item.description: Investors awaiting Reliance Jio Platforms IPO allotment results, expected on October 26, 2026, can check through BSE, NSE or registrar KFin Technologies using their application number, PAN or demat details. Shares are due to be credited, and refunds processed, on October 27.

item.title: Goldman Sachs Ola Electric Downgrade: Why stock rating changed to sell; 23% downside seen - New target price, rationale
item.description: Goldman Sachs downgraded Ola Electric to Sell and cut its price target to ₹23 from ₹39.28, citing weak cash flow, funding needs, high interest costs and operational challenges. It expects prolonged losses and tougher competition to hinder the company’s recovery.

item.title: Reliance Jio Platforms IPO GMP, allotment date, listing date, time, overall subscription status; QIB, NII, Retail, RIL
item.description: Reliance Jio Platforms’ ₹30,213-crore IPO allotment is expected on October 26, 2026. Investors can check status on the BSE, NSE or KFin Technologies websites. Shares are due to be credited on October 27, with the stock exchange listing scheduled for October 28.

item.title: Five Indian stocks offering dividend yields up to 10%
item.description: While trailing dividend yields offer an easy way to spot income opportunities, one-off special payouts, corporate demergers, and unsustainable payout ratios mean investors must look beyond headline numbers before buying in.

item.title: Top 3 stocks to buy: Eternal, Apollo Hospitals, Maruti Suzuki by Sumeet Bagadia | Target price, stoploss, market outlook
item.description: Stock market prediction for next week: Sumeet Bagadia of Choice Broking believes the technical chart of the Nifty 50 index hints at persistent selling pressure at higher levels

item.title: Mother of all IPOs! Jio Platforms shatters many existing records - Full list here
item.description: Jio Platforms’ ₹30,188-crore IPO became India’s largest, drawing bids of ₹4.72 lakh crore and more than 13.8 million applications. Strong demand across retail and institutional investors set records, with the company valued at up to ₹10.3 lakh crore ahead of its stock market debut.

item.title: IPO Subscription status comparison: Reliance Jio IPO vs Hyundai IPO vs NSE IPO - Who won the race?
item.description: Reliance Jio Platforms’ IPO closed with 22.19 times subscription, led by strong institutional demand at 70.55 times. It is set to surpass Hyundai Motor India’s 2024 IPO as India’s biggest-ever offering.

item.title: Sebi bars Avadhut Sathe, academy from markets, imposes ₹11.5 crore penalty
item.description: In a final order issued on Friday, the market regulator directed ASTAPL and its founder Avadhut Dinkar Sathe to disgorge and refund ₹546.17 crore to eligible investors and participants who paid for its unregistered services.

item.title: Supreme Petrochem Q2 results, dividend 2026: Check amount, record date, yield, history, stock returns
item.description: Supreme Petrochem declared a first interim dividend of ₹2.50 per share for FY27, with October 30 set as the record date. In Q2 FY27, revenue rose 77.8% year-on-year to ₹1,956.7 crore and profit after tax nearly doubled to ₹94.9 crore.

item.title: Jio Platforms IPO draws record 10 million applications amid strong investor demand
item.description: The ₹30,213-crore offering was subscribed 22.19 times by Friday, according to the BSE, with demand far exceeding the shares reserved for institutional investors.

item.title: Chennai Petroleum vs MRPL: Which PSU refinery stock wins on Q2 profit, revenue, dividends? Experts weigh in on outlook
item.description: Chennai Petroleum and MRPL reported strong Q2FY27 results, with profits rising 212% to ₹2,247 crore and nearly threefold to ₹1,881 crore, respectively. Check the two PSU stocks' comparison

item.title: Reliance Jio IPO overall subscription status, GMP: Day 1, 2, 3 details; allotment, listing date, share price prediction
item.description: Reliance Jio Platforms’ IPO closed with 22.19 times overall subscription, after becoming fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening. Qualified institutional buyers led demand at 70.55 times, while retail investors subscribed 2.72 times.

item.title: Pulse of the Street: earnings strengthen, but stocks lose ground
item.description: Small caps led the decline as valuation worries and concerns over oil prices and borrowing costs overshadowed stronger corporate earnings.

item.title: Silver crashes ₹56000/kg from August peak; gold slides 23000/10 grams. What’s driving the selloff in precious metals
item.description: Silver has fallen ₹56,000 from its August peak, and gold has also declined sharply as higher yields reduce the appeal of non-yielding assets. Middle East tensions have pushed oil prices higher, adding to inflation concerns and uncertainty over the Federal Reserve’s next move.

item.title: 1647% return in 5 years: Welspun Corp wins ₹5,500 cr US gas pipeline order - What's next for this multibagger stock?
item.description: Welspun Corp shares fell 1.75% to ₹2,391.80 on Friday despite winning a ₹5,500-crore US gas pipeline order. The contract, scheduled for execution in 2028-29, lifts the company’s global order book to a record USD 5.25 billion.

item.title: Infosys ADRs plunge 7.5% in pre-market after company trims annual revenue growth forecast; Q2 net profit rises 6%
item.description: Shares of Infosys fell in US pre-market trading after it reduced its revenue growth forecast, raising concerns about weak demand for major technology projects and AI-driven competition.&nbsp;

item.title: NBFC stock crashes 25% in month, but ICICI Securities sees a potential 50% rally - Do you own it? Check target price
item.description: Aye Finance shares fell about 25.56% in a month, but ICICI Securities sees 50% upside and retains a Buy rating. It cut its target price to ₹200 from ₹285, citing near-term volatility, while highlighting the lender’s market position, execution and resilient asset quality.

item.title: UBS acquires 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM: What the warrant conversion means for India's wealth market - Decoded
item.description: UBS has acquired a 4.8% stake in Indian wealth manager 360 ONE WAM by converting warrants into 20.5 million equity shares. The investment follows a partnership that includes UBS selling its Indian onshore wealth business to 360 ONE. The company manages more than ₹9 lakh crore in assets.

item.title: Yes Bank AT1 bonds: Supreme Court overturns write-off, but will investors get coupon payments? What's the entire matter
item.description: Yes Bank is unlikely to pay coupons due this year on its AT-1 bonds, despite the Supreme Court overturning their 2020 write-off. The bank is reportedly preparing to seek a review, while bondholders seek clarity on unpaid coupons. Yes Bank says its capital ratio could fall by about 250 basis points.

item.title: FMCG stocks to buy: Anand Rathi names Marico, GCPL, Asian Paints, Mrs Bector Food - check ratings and target prices
item.description: Anand Rathi Research expects earnings growth across its FMCG coverage to improve over FY26–28, forecasting 10% revenue CAGR and 15% earnings CAGR. Its preferred picks are Marico, Godrej Consumer Products, Mrs Bector Food and Asian Paints, despite rising input costs and increased regulatory scrutiny.

item.title: Small-cap stock under ₹50 with 1:5 stock split, 1:1 bonus share history: Rights issue announced for ₹160 crore value
item.description: Small-cap stock under ₹50 traded ex-date to finalise the list of eligible shareholders for 1:5 stock split on 25 July 2025
